# Merging multiline text, stabilizing open work, and writing the final story

::: {.entry-summary-strip}
`11 LASTING MERGES AT CUTOFF`{.entry-status .status-merged} `5 OPEN AUTHORED PRS`{.entry-status .status-open}
:::

## Outcome

The final period combined one important merge, continued histogram implementation, collaborative renderer cleanup, external CI review, and preparation of an evidence-backed journal.

## Context

Multiline text had been a long-running branch from before GSoC. During this period I completed its final review changes, cleaned the tests and branch scope, verified the behavior, and the feature merged on August 19.

## What I Did

- Continued [PR #343](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/343), completing dynamic histogram updates, capturing pre-refresh test state, preserving fixed breaks, and checking JavaScript coverage.
- Merged [PR #261](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/261) on August 19. Multiline text now works in plot titles, axis titles, legend titles, and `geom_text()` labels.
- Continued collaborative [PR #253](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/253), replacing duplicated panel loops and adjusting precision tolerance without hiding real aspect errors.
- Revised [PR #288](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/288) to use `animint()`, a clearer loop, and named theme values.
- Repaired [PR #339](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/339) after the merged multiline-text pipeline changed shared newline rendering.
- Reviewed [PR #344](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/344), requesting failure-path coverage and questioning misleading 0.00% project-change results.
- Clarified PR #285’s supported and unsupported facet notation and stabilized an unrelated browser-timing failure locally.
- Verified all 71 instrumented lines in the new PR #343 `stat-bin.js` path locally.
- Prepared the final Quarto journal and recorded an honest extension request as a project-management challenge.

## Learnings

Visualization changes cross compiler output, SVG structure, text measurement, panel spacing, transitions, browser tests, documentation, and adjacent feature branches. I also learned that careful review is a contribution: a question about a failure path or misleading coverage result can improve CI even when I did not author the PR.

## Challenges / Notes

Academics and hackathons reduced my available time, so I requested a two-week final-evaluation extension. This belongs in the record as project management, not a technical accomplishment.

The cutoff is explicit: PR #336 was complete and open on August 24. It merged August 25 and is not included in the cutoff’s eleven lasting merges.

## Next Week Targets

- Publish short technical posts for features already merged into `master`.
- Continue review on open renderer and interaction branches.
- Keep post-cutoff outcomes dated separately from the submitted report.

The plot exercises the shipped multiline behavior in one place: the plot title, both axis titles, the legend title, and every `geom_text()` label render on multiple lines without overlap or cropping.

<details class="demo-code">
<summary>View the essential R code</summary>

```r
animint(
  multiline = ggplot(label_data, aes(x, y, colour = group)) +
    geom_point(aes(key = group), clickSelects = "group") +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = label_y, label = label, key = group),
      clickSelects = "group",
      showSelected = character()
    ) +
    scale_color_discrete(name = "Feature\nworkstream") +
    ggtitle("Multi-line text in Animint2\nMerged in PR #261") +
    xlab("Interactive labels\nclick a point or legend entry") +
    ylab("Renderer output\nwith measured spacing")
)
```

</details>
